About

Anthotypes is a personal project in alternative photography, made with pigments from turmeric and spinach. We created each image by hand, using plant colour as the photosensitive material. Exposed to sunlight, the pigment slowly fades, allowing the image to emerge through contrast and time. The work brings attention to the process itself, where light, plant and image shape the final result.
